meta.title: Bonjour — Learn French that you can actually use
meta.description: A calm, adult French-learning space. Real situations, clear next steps, and progress you can feel.

landing.headline: Learn French you can actually use.
landing.subheadline: A calm space for adults. No pressure games — just clear steps toward speaking French in real situations.
landing.welcomeNote: You set the pace. We show you the next useful thing to practise.
landing.ctaPrimary: Start — it only takes a minute
landing.feel1Body: You always know what to do now — not a pile of random lessons.
landing.feel2Body: Café, travel, work, housing… language tied to life, not abstract lists.
landing.feel3Body: We only show what you have demonstrated. That makes success feel real.
landing.differenceBody: Serious design, respectful tone, and evidence-based progress — so learning feels useful, not childish.
landing.howIntro: Five calm steps. You can stop and come back anytime.
landing.howStep2: Learn the language you need for it
landing.howStep5: Move to the next clear step
landing.footerBody: Start with a short welcome. No long form, no guilt if you pause.

0.title: Welcome — glad you are here
0.description: A few questions so we can personalise your path. Nothing is graded yet.

1.title: Why French?
1.description: Pick what matters to you. There is no wrong answer.

2.title: Which situations matter most?
2.description: We will prioritise practice you can use soon.

placement.title: A short placement
placement.subtitle: Just a few questions so we understand where you are. No pass or fail — only information.
placement.openPlaceholder: Type in French if you can — or leave blank

profile.title: Your learning profile
profile.subtitle: Built only from what we observed. It will get clearer as you learn.
profile.levelNote: A first estimate — not a permanent label.
profile.evidenceNote: « Not assessed » simply means we have not seen that skill yet.

dashboard.title: Here is a good next step
dashboard.allDone: Beautiful — you have shown all current goals
dashboard.allDoneBody: Explore the materials library, or check back when new scenarios appear.
dashboard.encourage: Small steps count. Coming back is already progress.

learn.writePlaceholder: Write in French — imperfect is fine…
learn.selfAssessPrompt: Based on what you practised — can you do this now?
learn.feedbackRecorded: Noted. Honesty helps your path stay accurate.
learn.feedbackNote: This is a self-review, clearly labelled.
learn.doneBody: You completed this step. Your dashboard is ready with what comes next.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.subtitle: Only abilities you have demonstrated. That is why this list feels meaningful.
progress.noneYet: Nothing listed yet — your first goal is waiting on the dashboard.
progress.note: Based on your evidence, including self-review where labelled.
